evidence: All decoupling caps sit tight against U1's pin rows (C1/C2 left, C4 right, C5 lower-right, C3 bottom) within a few mm with no parts interposed between cap and IC pins.
Signal chain reads left-to-right: SPI header J2 (left edge) -> PHY/controller U1 (center) -> RJ45 magnetics J1 (right), with power J3 entering from the top, no doubling back.

The ratsnest fan between U1's right pin row and J1's pad rows visibly crosses (lines from upper U1 pins reach the lower 9-12 pad row while lower pins reach pads 1/2), and the six J2-to-U1 lines converge with apparent intersections near U1's upper-left pads, forcing crossover traces.
No regulation stage exists on this board; the +3V3/GND input header J3 feeds U1 directly with decoupling placed at the IC, so input -> load order is satisfied.
